senses.gloss: obscene statutary devoted to the Sun (h. חַמָּנִים).
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 6:4">Targ. Ezek. VI, 4</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 6:6">6</cite>.

Targ. Is. XVII, 8; a. e. [In various ed. our w. is written חניס נ׳ in two words, also חֲנִיסְסַיָּא. Our w. seems to be a derivative of a stem חסס, with anorganic נ, having the meaning of nakedness, shame. (cmp חָסִית I, חֲסַד, חסף).]
